memory_live_recording: Recording selected process; trace duration is 10 seconds. Cancellation requests stopping only this recording session.
memory_live_bitmap_recording: Dumping the selected process's bitmap heap and extracting images. This may pause the app. Cancellation stops the owned host transfer/extraction; the Android dump may finish independently.
memory_live_ai_unavailable: AI evidence export is not connected for Native Heap, ART samples or Bitmap image dumps. A retained Java heap is not evidence for this workspace.
memory_live_published: Measured artifact analyzed and published; missing samples remain unavailable.
memory_live_exported: Verified artifact exported to the selected destination.
memory_live_native_boundary: 10 s · 4096-byte sampling · Android 10+. Native values are sampled recorded allocation accounting, not exact allocations or the full live heap. Net values may be negative.
memory_live_art_boundary: 10 s · 4096-byte sampling · Android 12+. com.android.art positive allocation samples only: no full coverage, object classes, deallocation, GC or retention claims.
memory_live_heap_columns: PID / UPID · callsite · sample rows · weighted allocation count / bytes · sampled net count / bytes · leaf frame
memory_live_no_samples: No allocation samples in this page. A nonempty trace does not prove profiling permission or observed allocations.
memory_live_bitmap_boundary: Android 15+ Bitmap.dumpData PNG images, extracted in the isolated worker. Ordinary HPROF Bitmap instances are not image dumps. Extraction is bounded; omitted images are explicit.
memory_live_bitmap_summary: Recorded {recorded} / discovered {discovered} · extracted {images} · omitted {omitted} · PNG storage {bytes} B
